page.content:
Tae kwon do sadist who used Shadaloo and then discarded it.

How Juri Han connects

  • Work: Street Fighter IV — Street Fighter IV introduced Juri Han to the World Warrior cast.
  • Faction: Shadaloo — Juri Han infiltrated Shadaloo to tear it apart from inside.
  • Character: Chun-Li — Juri's sadism is aimed at Chun-Li across later games.

What is Juri Han?

Juri Han is the Feng Shui Engine taekwondoin who infiltrated Shadaloo to ruin it from inside, a chaotic rival to Chun-Li and Cammy across Street Fighter IV and 6.

Key threads lead to Street Fighter IV, Shadaloo and Chun-Li.
